description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, Today, we celebrate our great country's independence and freedom and remember the ideals on which this country was founded. In the words of Theodore Roosevelt, the 26th president of the United States, "This country will not be a good place for any of us to live in unless we make it a good place for all of us to live in.”Wishing you a safe and happy 4th of July! Happy Birthday America!Best,
